source: Giji.WA (337 x 640x400 8bpp) with palette Niuqun.wa[same index]; loader 0x40bc37
scene_lookup: scene struct 0x4ac63c: byte kind, word image (set by the S-script scene op). Giji entry = image + {kind 0: 0, kind 2: 40, kind 1: 114}; palette Niuqun[entry] (0x40bd98); drawn at (0, 40) 640x400 (0x40bdbc)
storage: entries 0..39 and 114 are plain rows; all others are 8x8 tiles in row-major tile order (80x50 tiles) - converted to plain images here

buha.source: Buha.wa entry = scene image id (word 0x4ac63d, loader 0x428857, buffer 0x4aeb38)
buha.format: 14-byte header (7 LE words: [id, 100, 100, 1, 200, 100, 1]) + 2 bytes + 200x100 bytes; values 0xFF / 0xF0 (scene walk/occlusion mask - semantics unverified); word@8 (=200) is the W used by the actor screen transform
